verdict.rationale: The evidence shows React supports TypeScript through @types/react and typed component props, but nothing shows React-provided AI tooling that automatically resolves type errors. React Compiler handles memoization, eslint-plugin-react-hooks catches bugs, and llms.txt exposes docs to LLMs; these are adjacent features, not automated type-error resolution.

support.subject: As an ai-native developer, I can use AI tooling that automatically resolves type errors surfaced by the framework's type system
